prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try moving your pet or right-clicking to open the control menu.", "Master Quick Controls", "1. Drag pet to move\n2. Double-click to talk\n3. Tray icon to hide"]
1: ["Ensure bright lighting and a clear front view of your pet for best results.", "Best Results: Single Subject, Well Lit", "Photo Quality Checklist", "Clear focus • No heavy shadows • Face fully visible"]
2: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Use your primary account so your pet and items are preserved across devices.", "Sign In Method", "Choose your primary sign-in to protect your pet save file"]
3: []
4: ["How Would You Like to Pick Your Pet?", "Select a ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from photos.", "Onboarding Paths", "Instant Pick (Fast) vs Custom Creation (Unique)"]
5: []

7: ["Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon your pet to your mouse cursor!"]
8: ["Your Desktop's New Best Friend", "Adopt a virtual companion that lives right on your desktop, keeps you focused, and brightens your workday.", "Start Adoption"]
9: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to make it official!", "Certified Desktop Companion", "Pet Name", "Enter your pet's name"]
